name: Tank Level Control
requirement: Maintain water level in tank T-03. Fill_Pump runs when level drops below Low_Level. Fill_Pump stops when High_Level is reached. High_High_Level triggers overflow alarm and stops pump immediately.
safety_constraints: High_High_Level must force Fill_Pump off immediately.
Emergency_Stop must force Fill_Pump off immediately.
System_Ready must be false during active overflow alarm.

expected_properties.description: Pump is disabled on high-high level.
Overflow alarm is raised on high-high level.
